prompt:
A desktop web app screen for Monochrome, a self-hosted music player, rendered edge to edge with crisp readable text, no browser window, no device, no desk. This is the Social page, where the members of a small private instance see what everyone is listening to right now.

What leads: one continuous record shelf spanning the page width, the community's whole day filed in time. On the left, narrow vertical record spines (thin slices of colourful album covers, titles printed sideways, a tiny member initial at each foot) above hour marks 6 PM, 7 PM, 8 PM, 9 PM. A slim "Now" marker. At the right end, the records playing right now are pulled out face-forward as large square sleeves standing on the shelf: "Saltwater Hours - Cass Arlo" with two round avatars (Inez, Jon) on its corner, "Neon Margins - Juno Park" with Mara, "Slow Orbit - The Pale Hours" with Theo, each with a thin progress line along its lower edge. Small cream paper shelf-talker cards are tucked in front of records with members' notes: "This outro is unreal. Mara, 20h left" and "Album of the year? Velvet Static, still. Sol". Labels along the shelf edge under each face-out record give title, artist, listener and emoji reaction counts.

Below the shelf, quieter: "This week on the shelf" ranked chart, "Kindred listeners" (Mara, 14 artists in common), and a poll "Best track on Velvet Static?". Header: "Social", "4 listening now, 38 plays on the shelf today", controls "Friends see you", "Ghost", "Messages 2" and a white button "Leave a note".

Monochrome's look: a near-black app ground with charcoal panels and faint hairline dividers, off-white text, white pill-shaped primary buttons and round icon buttons; the interface itself is colourless and every bit of colour comes from album artwork, whose hues softly tint the space around the largest covers. Titles in a tight bold neo-grotesk, UI text in a clean sans like Inter. Calm, spacious and premium, like a high-end music player, never a dashboard or a social-media feed. All album covers are invented abstract artwork and all names are fictional sample data.

The full app frame: a left sidebar with the Monochrome logo (two overlapping white squares) and navigation Home, Library, Upload, Social (active, white pill), Listening stats, Settings; a top bar with back/forward circle buttons and a wide search field reading "Search for tracks, artists, albums..."; a floating rounded player bar along the bottom playing "Weathervane - Cass Arlo".
